services.name: Sunday Nature & Heritage Tours
services.desc: Your 50-min guided journey uncovers the serenity and beauty found along the Blackstone River in Central Falls, Cumberland, and Lincoln. Learn about this interesting landscape...enjoy a chance glimpse at the river wildlife that inhabits this tight urban area...and discover why this geography attracted settlers and industries to the Blackstone 50 Minute Tour • All Ages • Uncover the serenity and beauty found along the Blackstone River!

services.name: Saturday Evening Serenity Cruises
services.desc: Grab a drink at Shark's Peruvian then hop aboard our 40-passenger boat for a 50-minute UNGUIDED CRUISE up the Blackstone River to take in the scenery, listen to some relaxing music, and enjoy a nice evening on the water!! Show your tickets at SHARK'S TO RECEIVE 10% OFF FOOD & DRINK on the DAY OF YOUR TRIP! Make a reservation to enjoy a meal once you return to Central Falls Landing. You can reserve a table at sharksperuviancuisine.com Evening River Cruises on The Explorer run on Saturday nights at 5 PM and 6 50 Minute Unguided Cruise • Grab a drink and enjoy a nice evening on the water!

services.name: 90 Minute Guided Kayak Tour
services.desc: Book Now - We Sell Out! 90 Minutes About One of the best ways to experience Blackstone Valley is on the river! Join us and you’ll be able to explore the Valley Falls Mill Pond and Firestone Cove along the Blackstone River! During your journey you'll take in some nice scenery, historic mills, and possibly see the many species of wildlife that call this waterway home including egrets, painted turtles, cormorants, osprey, and “Sam” the lone mute swan. More info All rentals depart from Central Falls Landing. A minimum number of kayakers will need to have signed up for the session to run. Single Kayaks • Tandem Kayaks

services.name: Float and Film on the Blackstone
services.desc: Guided 1-hour session on shooting and directing a 1–2 minute iPhone video of the Blackstone River with wildlife filmmaker Gerry Krausse.

services.name: Voices on the Blackstone: Featuring Amanda Mograss
services.desc: One-hour evening sing-along boat cruise on the Blackstone River with live music by Amanda Mograss.

services.name: Haunted Blackstone: Ghost Stories River Tour with Tom D'Agostino
services.desc: Guided haunted storytelling cruise through Rhode Island’s Blackstone Valley with paranormal expert Tom D'Agostino. Hear haunted stories from around RI's Blackstone Valley aboard The Explorer!
